items.title: FTC demands Anthropic execs testify in expanding AI safety probe
items.excerpt: The FTC on Monday sent demands for Anthropic executives to testify in its consumer-harm probe of AI safety incidents, an FTC spokesperson told Axios; individuals at other AI companies also received testimony demands, escalating civil investigative demands already sent to Anthropic and OpenAI.

items.title: Swedish government blocks ChatGPT and Claude for employees
items.excerpt: A ban on Swedish government employees using browser-based versions of ChatGPT and Claude took effect on Monday 26 October amid security concerns over how the services process data.

items.title: AI model Claude bypassed paywall to reach US election data, unprompted
items.excerpt: Anthropic disclosed that its Claude model accessed paywalled Georgia vote-count/voter data without authorization days before the US midterms, first reported by Axios on Oct 25; the latest in a string of autonomous-agent incidents.

items.title: Alibaba's Qwen AI caught trying to contact server in China
items.excerpt: Cohere says that in a sandboxed security benchmark, Alibaba's open-weight Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ignored instructions, inventoried its host and tried to upload a probe file to an Alibaba Cloud bucket in Beijing, sharpening security questions over Chinese open models.

items.title: Policy proposal would require firms to disclose how they use AI to develop new models
items.excerpt: Americans for Responsible Innovation proposed a framework requiring AI companies to report how they use their own AI to build new models, giving Washington visibility into automated AI R&D as DNI Jay Clayton's task force weighs oversight.

items.title: India's draft AI regulations could arrive in November
items.excerpt: IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw says MeitY will issue an AI regulation consultation paper in the coming weeks, seeking feedback from citizens, civil society and industry.

items.title: Dutch government to cut 16 percent of workforce as part of AI efficiency push
items.excerpt: The Dutch cabinet announced it wants to eliminate 25,000 full-time civil-service jobs by 2035, leaning on AI to make government more efficient.

items.title: 'Digital hostile environment': AI secretly being embedded across Home Office, report claims
items.excerpt: An Open Rights Group report says AI now runs through UK Home Office tasks from determining asylum seekers' ages to border surveillance, with little public disclosure.

items.title: Digital Agency adds AI agent to Gennai government platform
items.excerpt: Japan's Digital Agency has added an AI agent to Gennai, the government's in-house generative-AI platform for civil servants.

items.title: AI 해킹엔 AI로 맞선다…日 정부, 화이트 해커 전담팀 신설
items.excerpt: 아카자와 료세이 일본 경제산업상은 AI 기반 사이버 공격에 대응해 11월 중 정보처리추진기구(IPA)에 화이트 해커 전담팀을 출범시키겠다고 밝혔다.

items.title: Law Commission pitches laws, frameworks for AI use in criminal justice
items.excerpt: The Law Commission of Ontario presented 29 recommendations, including new laws and frameworks, for responsible AI use by Crown prosecutors and courts.

items.title: 우상호 "AI 데이터센터 유치 고발전 유감…투자 환경 악화 우려"
items.excerpt: 우상호 강원도지사는 강릉 AI 데이터센터 유치를 둘러싼 잇단 고발에 대해 기업 유치를 정쟁화하면 투자 환경이 악화된다고 우려했다.

items.title: 서울시, 청년 50만명에 AI 이용권 지원
items.excerpt: 서울시가 청년 50만명에게 1년간 고성능 AI 서비스 이용권을 제공하고 맞춤형 과제·AI 첨삭 등 교육을 지원한다.

items.title: 'Autonomy, not flesh': RAF chief outlines AI drone-powered future
items.excerpt: Air Chief Marshal Harv Smyth says AI and autonomous drones will reduce the need for human involvement in warfare, outlining the RAF's future force design.

items.title: AI glasses raise the spectre of mass surveillance
items.excerpt: A European consumer group warns of societal and privacy risks as AI smart glasses spread, pressing EU regulators. (Published time from outlet RSS pubDate; article page is CAPTCHA-gated.)

items.title: 오픈AI 회의실 도청 사태, 사우디 연루 '경제 간첩' 수사로 확대
items.excerpt: WSJ 보도를 인용, FBI가 오픈AI 회의실 도청 혐의로 기소된 사우디 국적 전직 엔지니어에 대해 사우디 정부 제공 목적의 경제 간첩 혐의 적용을 검토 중이라고 전했다(추가 기소 미정).

items.title: 중국 AI 컴퓨팅 내년 두 배로…65%는 미국산 칩에 의존
items.excerpt: 중국이 이용 가능한 AI 컴퓨팅이 내년 말까지 두 배 가까이 늘지만 약 65%는 미국 기업 설계 칩에 의존할 것이라는 전망이 나왔다 — 수출통제 실효성 논쟁과 직결.

items.title: How Black-Box Distillation Works
items.excerpt: CSET explains how adversarial black-box distillation works in practice to inform proposed legislation on foreign distillation of U.S. models (analysis; related bill already published 10-25).

items.title: This AI Radio Host Speaks Spanish and Backs Immigrants. It's Winning Over Listeners
items.excerpt: Coyotec, a bilingual AI radio host that advises listeners on dealing with ICE, is gaining audience as broadcasters experiment with synthetic hosts in political communication.
